script.title: THE COINS LANE
script.story_hook: Leo's card fails right at the toll booth window.
script.intro_zh: 里歐的信用卡在收費站失靈了。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back to the highway. Today we pay at a toll booth.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回到高速公路上，今天來學在收費站付錢。
script.outro: Quarters saved the day. Now you know the coins lane. Safe travels!
script.outro_zh: 硬幣救了這一站，你現在也認識零錢專用道了。一路順風！
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat the toll booth lines together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們一起把收費站的句子跟讀一遍。
script.char_a_description: a young man in his late twenties, short curly dark brown hair, light beard, mustard hoodie under a jean jacket, travel backpack on one shoulder, average build, tired but friendly face
script.char_b_description: a cheerful woman in her sixties, silver bob haircut, round blue glasses, reflective orange safety vest over a grey uniform shirt, name tag clipped on, plump build, warm patient smile

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, do you take cards here?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，這裡收信用卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, hon. Just tap the reader.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du hɑn dʒʌst tæp ðə ˈɹidɚ/
dialogue.zh: 收啊，親，碰一下讀卡機就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I tapped twice. It says declined.
dialogue.zh: 我觸了兩次，都顯示拒絕交易。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, the reader's moody in rain.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，下雨天讀卡機偶爾會鬧脾氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So what else can I try?
dialogue.zh: 那我還能用什麼付？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coins work anytime here.
dialogue.zh: 硬幣在這裡隨時都能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Um, how much is the toll?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ʌm haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðə toʊl/
dialogue.zh: 好，呃，過路費是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three twenty-five, two-axle car.
dialogue.zh: 雙軸小車，三塊二毛五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coins. Okay, give me one second.
dialogue.zh: 硬幣喔，好，給我一下下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, sweetie. Rain's bad.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，外面雨下得真大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where are they... console box, come on.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛɹ ɑɹ ðeɪ kənˈsoʊl bɑks kʌm ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 放哪了……副駕駛置物盒，拜託。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found some? Or need me to wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd sʌm ɑɹ nid mi tə weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 找到一些了嗎？還是要我等你？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I've got maybe two dollars here.
dialogue.zh: 我這裡大概只有兩塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's three twenty-five, remember.
dialogue.zh: 記得是三塊二毛五喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, right... um, one more pocket.
dialogue.zh: 對喔對喔……再摸一下另一個口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hey, want a trick for next time?
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ wɑn ə tɹɪk fɚ nɛkst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 嘿，想不想學個下次管用的竅門？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please, I need all the help.
dialogue.zh: 拜託，我太需要了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep a coin cup in your door.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ə kɔɪn kʌp ɪn ɔɹ dɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 在車門置物格放個裝硬幣的小杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart. Almost there... got the last one!
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ˈɔˈlmoʊst ðɛɹ ɡɑt ðə læst wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。快了……找到最後一枚！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That makes three twenty-five exactly.
dialogue.zh: 這樣剛剛好，三塊二毛五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whew, there it all goes in.
dialogue.zh: 呼，全部丟進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much better. Any quarters left over?
dialogue.zh: 好多了，還剩下幾分硬幣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just a few dimes and nickels.
dialogue.zh: 只剩幾個一毛和五分的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Feed the machine. It sorts them.
dialogue.zh: 通通倒進機器，它會自動分類。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I get a paper receipt?
dialogue.zh: 會拿到紙本收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, from this little slot.
dialogue.zh: 給，就是從這個小洞口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Thanks, you saved my trip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt θæŋks ju seɪvd maɪ tɹɪp/
dialogue.zh: 收到了，謝謝你，救了我的旅程。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My pleasure, love. That's the job.
dialogue.zh: 我的榮幸啦，工作就是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing before I go.
dialogue.zh: 走之前還有一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what's on your mind?
dialogue.zh: 好呀，你想問什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why did the light flash red?
dialogue.zh: 剛剛為什麼紅燈一直在閃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're in the exact-change lane.
dialogue.zh: 你走的是精確零錢專用道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So no change back from the machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ noʊ tʃeɪndʒ bæk fɹəm ðə məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 所以機器不會找你錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None. Pay exactly, or pull ahead.
dialogue.zh: 不會，要付得剛好，不然就開前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know. My line felt long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ maɪ laɪn fɛlt lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 還好問了，我剛剛覺得隊伍好長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Folks rush. Rain makes drivers crazy.
dialogue.zh: 大家都急，雨天的司機比高速路上的還凶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me about it. Nobody honks, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi əˈbaʊt ɪt ˈnoʊˌbɑːdi hɔŋks ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 就是說啊，不過怎麼沒有人按喇叭？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They gave up ten booths back.
dialogue.zh: 他們在十個收費亭前就放棄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, that's comforting, somehow.
dialogue.zh: 哈，不知為何還蠻安慰的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want my advice for the return?
dialogue.zh: 回程想不想要我的建議？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, please. I'm listening.
dialogue.zh: 要，請說，我認真聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy a transponder at the gift shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ə tɹænsˈpɑndɚ æt ðə ɡɪft ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 去禮品店買一個電子感應器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The beep-beep thing? Isn't that pricey?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bip bip θɪŋ ɪzənt ðæt ˈpɹaɪsi/
dialogue.zh: 就是嗶嗶叫那個？不會很貴嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine dollars, and tolls cost less.
dialogue.zh: 九塊，而且過路費比較便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now you're speaking my language.
dialogue.zh: 你這句我最有興趣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stick it by your windshield, top corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪk ɪt baɪ ɔɹ ˈwɪndʃiːld tɑp ˈkɔɹnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 把它貼在擋風玻璃右上角。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And I just drive through slowly?
dialogue.zh: 然後我慢慢開過去就好了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, it beeps, the gate lifts.
dialogue.zh: 對，它一嗶，桿子就抬起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect for a clumsy card guy like me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt fɚ ə ˈklʌmzi kɑɹd ɡaɪ laɪk mi/
dialogue.zh: 像我這種卡片用不順的人最適合。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We've all been there, hon. Drive safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪv ɔːl bɪn ðɛɹ hɑn dɹaɪv seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 大家都遇過，親。開車小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Are the roads clear north?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ɑɹ ðə ɹoʊdz klɪɹ nɔɹθ/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。北路路況好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clear now. A truck spilled gravel earlier.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪɹ naʊ ə tɹʌk spɪld ˈɡɹævəl ˈɜɹliɚ/
dialogue.zh: 現在通了，先前有卡車灑了碎石。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for the heads-up.
dialogue.zh: 多虧你提前告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fill your gas before Millerstown, too.
dialogue.zh: 還有，過米勒鎮前先加滿油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted. Long stretch ahead?
dialogue.zh: 記下了，前面路很長嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty miles, yeah. Nothing open there.
dialogue.zh: 六十英里，那邊什麼都沒開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You just planned my whole evening.
dialogue.zh: 你幫我把整個晚上都規畫好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the bonus at this window.
dialogue.zh: 在這個窗口，這是額外服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have a good shift, and thanks again!
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ə ɡʊd ʃɪft ənd θæŋks əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 值班順利，再一次謝謝！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too, love. Mind the rain.
dialogue.zh: 你也是，小心路滑雨大。

script.youtube_title_en: Do You Take Cards? - Paying Coins at a Rainy Toll Booth
script.youtube_description:
「Do you take cards?」刷卡失靈的瞬間，收費站窗口該說什麼？這一集 60 句美式英文對話：雨天、收費站、一位資深收費員，一步一步教你脫困。

你會聽到：
- 付款失敗的說法（It says declined.）
- 硬幣、紙鈔、零錢專用道（Coins work anytime. / exact-change lane）
- 面額的英文名（quarters, dimes, nickels）
- 電子感應器怎麼買怎麼貼（Buy a transponder. Stick it by your windshield.）

從找不到硬幣、金額差一點點，到拿到收據、聽完路況建議，整段對話在同一個場景裡自然推進。

"Do you take cards?" - one continuous 60-line scene at a rainy toll booth. The card fails, the coins are missing by seventy cents, and a veteran attendant turns the moment into a mini lesson on quarters, exact-change lanes, and transponders.

You will hear real phrases like: "It says declined.", "Coins work anytime here.", "You're in the exact-change lane.", "Nine dollars, and tolls cost less."

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so the phrases stick without memorizing.

📌 影片簡介：
信用卡在收費站視窗顯示拒絕的那一秒，你講得出英文嗎？
quarter、dime、nickel 分得清楚嗎？
這一集帶大家走進雨夜的收費站窗口：司機里歐和資深收費員一起把硬幣數到剛剛好。

你會聽到：
- 💳 付款失敗：I tapped twice. It says declined.
- 🪙 數硬幣：Three twenty-five, two-axle car. / Any quarters left over?
- 🛑 專用道知識：You're in the exact-change lane.
- 📻 感應器建議：Buy a transponder at the gift shop.

願你下次經過收費站，搖下車窗時，心裡已經先說完了那句：Coins, please.
